name: labs/ledger-donjon__pypdm
title: AlphANOV PDM laser source (pypdm.pdm:PDM)
intro: AlphANOV PDM laser source (pypdm.pdm:PDM), adapted from ledger-donjon/pypdm. It reads `address`, `protocol_version`, `activation`, `interlock_closed` and 13 more; runs `configure_pulse` and `disable_emission`. `configure_pulse`: write the pulse frequency and the diode current instructions and apply them to the device. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ledger-donjon__pypdm --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ledger-donjon__pypdm --backend fake --mcp
